Search request with max_results parameter limiting response count

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.searchRequestFromJson("{\"max_results\":2,\"model\":\"brave/web-search\",\"query\":\"Rust programming\"}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
let result = try await _client.search(_req)
debugPrint(result.results)
```
